input.question: What is the population of Young America Township?

documents.text: Young America Township, Carver County, Minnesota Young America Township is a township in Carver County, Minnesota, United States. The population was 1,200 as of the 2000 census. Due to the presence of a major rebate-processing center, Young America Corporation, the town has more than 20 ZIP codes. 55397 is the actual delivery ZIP code for the town, whereas all ZIP codes beginning with 555 are reserved for rebate, contest, and fulfillment services. According to the United States Census Bureau, the township has a total area of 34.1 square miles (88.3 km²), of which 32.8 square miles (84.9 km²) is land.
